component.name: Seven
component.summary: Light windows, see-through blue title bars and panel

description.p: A light style for the FlickOS desktop: windows in the Arc theme, sky blue title bars you can see through, a see-through dark blue panel, a black terminal and a sky wallpaper. It suits the Redmond layout best.
After installing it, try it until you log out, or use it. It is listed with Dark and Light in Desktop Layout & Style.
